verses.original: יַעֲקֹ֜ב וַיִּשָּׂ֨א עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּרְא֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה עֵשָׂ֣ו בָּ֔א וְעִמּ֕וֹ אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וַיַּ֣חַץ אֶת־ הַיְלָדִ֗ים עַל־ לֵאָה֙ וְעַל־ רָחֵ֔ל וְעַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֥י הַשְּׁפָחֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yiś·śā ‘ê·nāw way·yar wə·hin·nêh ‘ê·śāw bā wə·‘im·mōw ’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ ’îš way·ya·ḥaṣ ’eṯ- hay·lā·ḏîm ‘al- lê·’āh wə·‘al- rā·ḥêl wə·‘al šə·tê haš·šə·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ
verses.literal: Now Jacob looked up . . . and saw . . . Esau coming toward him with four hundred men So he divided - the children . . . among Leah . . . Rachel . . . and the two maidservants

verses.original: וַיָּ֧שֶׂם אֶת־ הַשְּׁפָח֛וֹת וְאֶת־ יַלְדֵיהֶ֖ן רִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְאֶת־ לֵאָ֤ה וִֽילָדֶ֙יהָ֙ אַחֲרֹנִ֔ים וְאֶת־ רָחֵ֥ל וְאֶת־ יוֹסֵ֖ף אַחֲרֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem ’eṯ- haš·šə·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- yal·ḏê·hen ri·šō·nāh wə·’eṯ- lê·’āh wî·lā·ḏe·hā ’a·ḥă·rō·nîm wə·’eṯ- rā·ḥêl wə·’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄ ’a·ḥă·rō·nîm
verses.literal: He put - the maidservants and their children in front - Leah and her children next - and Rachel - and Joseph at the rear

verses.original: וְה֖וּא עָבַ֣ר לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֤חוּ אַ֙רְצָה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים עַד־ גִּשְׁתּ֖וֹ עַד־ אָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū ‘ā·ḇar lip̄·nê·hem way·yiš·ta·ḥū ’ar·ṣāh še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm ‘aḏ- giš·tōw ‘aḏ- ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: But [Jacob] himself went on ahead and bowed to the ground seven times as he approached . . . his brother

verses.original: עֵשָׂ֤ו לִקְרָאתוֹ֙ וַיָּ֨רָץ וַֽיְחַבְּקֵ֔הוּ וַיִּפֹּ֥ל עַל־ צַוָּארָ֖ו וַׄיִּׄשָּׁׄקֵ֑ׄהׄוּׄ וַיִּבְכּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·śāw liq·rā·ṯōw way·yā·rāṣ way·ḥab·bə·qê·hū way·yip·pōl ‘al- ṣaw·wå̄·rå̄w way·yiš·šå̄·qē·hū way·yiḇ·kū
verses.literal: Esau, however . . . ran to him and embraced him threw his arms around . . . his neck and kissed him And they both wept

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א אֶת־ עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּ֤רְא אֶת־ הַנָּשִׁים֙ וְאֶת־ הַיְלָדִ֔ים וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־ אֵ֣לֶּה לָּ֑ךְ וַיֹּאמַ֕ר הַיְלָדִ֕ים אֲשֶׁר־ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ חָנַ֥ן עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā ’eṯ- ‘ê·nāw way·yar ’eṯ- han·nā·šîm wə·’eṯ- hay·lā·ḏîm way·yō·mer mî- ’êl·leh lāḵ way·yō·mar hay·lā·ḏîm ’ă·šer- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- ḥā·nan ‘aḇ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: When Esau looked up - - and saw - the women - and children he asked Who are these with you [Jacob] answered [These are] the children - God - has graciously given your servant

verses.original: הַשְּׁפָח֛וֹת הֵ֥נָּה וְיַלְדֵיהֶ֖ן וַתִּגַּ֧שְׁןָ וַתִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶֽיןָ׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ hên·nāh wə·yal·ḏê·hen wat·tig·gaš·nā wat·tiš·ta·ḥă·we·nā
verses.literal: Then the maidservants and their children approached and bowed down

verses.original: לֵאָ֛ה וִילָדֶ֖יהָ גַּם־ וַתִּגַּ֧שׁ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֑וּ וְאַחַ֗ר יוֹסֵ֛ף וְרָחֵ֖ל נִגַּ֥שׁ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lê·’āh wî·lā·ḏe·hā gam- wat·tig·gaš way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū wə·’a·ḥar yō·w·sêp̄ wə·rā·ḥêl nig·gaš way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū
verses.literal: Leah and her children also approached and bowed down and then Joseph and Rachel approached and bowed down

verses.original: מִ֥י לְךָ֛ הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּל־ הַמַּחֲנֶ֥ה פָּגָ֑שְׁתִּי וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לִמְצֹא־ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר
verses.transliteration: mî lə·ḵā haz·zeh ’ă·šer kāl- ham·ma·ḥă·neh pā·ḡā·šə·tî way·yō·mer lim·ṣō- ḥên bə·‘ê·nê ’ă·ḏō·nî way·yō·mer
verses.literal: What do you mean by sending this - whole company to meet me asked Esau To find favor in your sight my lord [Jacob] answered

verses.original: יֶשׁ־ לִ֣י רָ֑ב אָחִ֕י עֵשָׂ֖ו וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהִ֥י לְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁר־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yeš- lî rāḇ ’ā·ḥî ‘ê·śāw way·yō·mer yə·hî lə·ḵā ’ă·šer- lāḵ
verses.literal: I already have plenty my brother Esau replied Keep what belongs to you

verses.original: יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַל־ נָא֙ אִם־ נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ מִנְחָתִ֖י מִיָּדִ֑י עַל־ כֵּ֞ן כִּ֣י רָאִ֣יתִי פָנֶ֗יךָ כִּרְאֹ֛ת פְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַתִּרְצֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yō·mer ’al- nā ’im- nā mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā wə·lā·qaḥ·tā min·ḥā·ṯî mî·yā·ḏî ‘al- kên kî rā·’î·ṯî p̄ā·ne·ḵā kir·’ōṯ pə·nê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wat·tir·ṣê·nî
verses.literal: But Jacob insisted No please If . . . I have found favor in your sight then receive this gift from my hand For . . . indeed I have seen your face and it is like seeing the face of God since you have received me favorably

verses.original: נָ֤א אֶת־ קַח־ בִּרְכָתִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֻבָ֣את לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְכִ֣י חַנַּ֥נִי לִי־ יֶשׁ־ כֹ֑ל וַיִּפְצַר־ בּ֖וֹ וַיִּקָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: nā ’eṯ- qaḥ- bir·ḵā·ṯî ’ă·šer hu·ḇāṯ lāḵ kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ḵî ḥan·na·nî lî- yeš- ḵōl way·yip̄·ṣar- bōw way·yiq·qāḥ
verses.literal: Please - accept my gift that was brought to you because God . . . has been gracious to me and I have all I need So Jacob pressed him until he accepted

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר נִסְעָ֣ה וְנֵלֵ֑כָה וְאֵלְכָ֖ה לְנֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer nis·‘āh wə·nê·lê·ḵāh wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh lə·neḡ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Then Esau said Let us be on our way . . . and I will go ahead of you

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו אֲדֹנִ֤י יֹדֵ֙עַ֙ כִּֽי־ הַיְלָדִ֣ים רַכִּ֔ים עָלָ֑י וְהַצֹּ֥אן וְהַבָּקָ֖ר עָל֣וֹת וּדְפָקוּם֙ אֶחָ֔ד י֣וֹם כָּל־ הַצֹּֽאן׃ וָמֵ֖תוּ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ă·ḏō·nî yō·ḏê·a‘ kî- hay·lā·ḏîm rak·kîm ‘ā·lāy wə·haṣ·ṣōn wə·hab·bā·qār ‘ā·lō·wṯ ū·ḏə·p̄ā·qūm ’e·ḥāḏ yō·wm kāl- haṣ·ṣōn wā·mê·ṯū
verses.literal: But Jacob replied . . . My lord knows that the children are frail and I must care for sheep and cattle that are nursing their young If they are driven hard for even a day all the animals will die

verses.original: נָ֥א אֲדֹנִ֖י יַעֲבָר־ לִפְנֵ֣י עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַאֲנִ֞י אֶֽתְנָהֲלָ֣ה לְאִטִּ֗י לְרֶ֨גֶל אֲשֶׁר־ לְפָנַי֙ וּלְרֶ֣גֶל הַמְּלָאכָ֤ה הַיְלָדִ֔ים עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־ אָבֹ֥א אֶל־ אֲדֹנִ֖י שֵׂעִֽירָה׃
verses.transliteration: nā ’ă·ḏō·nî ya·‘ă·ḇār- lip̄·nê ‘aḇ·dōw wa·’ă·nî ’eṯ·nā·hă·lāh lə·’iṭ·ṭî lə·re·ḡel ’ă·šer- lə·p̄ā·nay ū·lə·re·ḡel ham·mə·lā·ḵāh hay·lā·ḏîm ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- ’ā·ḇō ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nî śê·‘î·rāh
verses.literal: Please let my lord go ahead of his servant I will continue on slowly at a comfortable pace - - . . . for the livestock and children until - I come to my lord at Seir

verses.original: אַצִּֽיגָה־ נָּ֣א מִן־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתִּ֑י הָעָ֖ם עִמְּךָ֔ עֵשָׂ֔ו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לָ֣מָּה זֶּ֔ה אֶמְצָא־ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’aṣ·ṣî·ḡāh- nā min- ’ă·šer ’it·tî hā·‘ām ‘im·mə·ḵā ‘ê·śāw way·yō·mer way·yō·mer lām·māh zeh ’em·ṣā- ḥên bə·‘ê·nê ’ă·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: Let me leave . . . some of my . . . people with you Esau said But [Jacob] replied Why do that Let me find favor in the sight of my lord

verses.original: הַה֥וּא בַּיּ֨וֹם עֵשָׂ֛ו לְדַרְכּ֖וֹ וַיָּשָׁב֩ שֵׂעִֽירָה׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm ‘ê·śāw lə·ḏar·kōw way·yā·šāḇ śê·‘î·rāh
verses.literal: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir

verses.original: וְיַעֲקֹב֙ נָסַ֣ע סֻכֹּ֔תָה וַיִּ֥בֶן בָּ֑יִת ל֖וֹ סֻכֹּ֔ת וּלְמִקְנֵ֙הוּ֙ עָשָׂ֣ה עַל־ כֵּ֛ן הַמָּק֖וֹם קָרָ֥א שֵׁם־ סֻכּֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ nā·sa‘ suk·kō·ṯāh way·yi·ḇen bā·yiṯ lōw suk·kōṯ ū·lə·miq·nê·hū ‘ā·śāh ‘al- kên ham·mā·qō·wm qā·rā šêm- suk·kō·wṯ
verses.literal: but Jacob went on to Succoth where he built a house for himself and shelters for his livestock . . . that is why . . . the place was called . . . Succoth

verses.original: יַעֲקֹ֨ב וַיָּבֹא֩ מִפַּדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם בְּבֹא֖וֹ שָׁלֵ֜ם עִ֣יר שְׁכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן וַיִּ֖חַן אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yā·ḇō mip·pad·dan ’ă·rām bə·ḇō·’ōw šā·lêm ‘îr šə·ḵem ’ă·šer bə·’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an way·yi·ḥan ’eṯ- pə·nê hā·‘îr
verses.literal: After Jacob had come vvv from Paddan-aram he arrived safely at the city of Shechem - in the land of Canaan and he camped . . . just outside the city

verses.original: חֶלְקַ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽטָה־ שָׁם֙ אָהֳל֔וֹ וַיִּ֜קֶן אֶת־ מִיַּ֥ד בְּנֵֽי־ חֲמ֖וֹר שְׁכֶ֑ם אֲבִ֣י בְּמֵאָ֖ה קְשִׂיטָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥel·qaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ’ă·šer nā·ṭāh- šām ’ā·ho·lōw way·yi·qen ’eṯ- mî·yaḏ bə·nê- ḥă·mō·wr šə·ḵem ’ă·ḇî bə·mê·’āh qə·śî·ṭāh
verses.literal: And the plot of ground where he pitched . . . his tent he purchased - from the sons of Hamor Shechem’s father for a hundred pieces of silver

verses.original: שָׁ֖ם וַיַּצֶּב־ מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּ֨קְרָא־ ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: šām way·yaṣ·ṣeḇ- miz·bê·aḥ way·yiq·rā- lōw ’êl ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: There he set up an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel . . . . . .
